prompt: Five Nights at Freddy's initial game release came one day short of the 19 year anniversary of the death of which Grateful Dead band member?
answer: Jerry Garcia, the Grateful Dead’s guitarist and vocalist, died on August 9, 1995. *Five Nights at Freddy’s* was initially released on August 8, 2014—one day before the 19th anniversary.
